description: The canonical, exact set of --p42-* composition tokens every layout bundle in web/layouts/ must declare -- no more, no less. This is the single declared list T-18 should have changed and did not: adding a token to every layout.json without also changing a list like this one is how project42-gallery's own copies (and its separately hand-maintained required-token list) fell behind with nothing failing until the consuming portal's token-completeness check caught it, downstream and late. web/scripts/layout-tokens-check.mjs enforces this list against every layout in this repository; project42-gallery vendors it (scripts/sync-platform-layouts.mjs) to derive its own required-token list instead of hand-maintaining a parallel one.
